# Acceptance checklist

<!-- docsync:auto:begin - generated by docsync, edits inside this block are overwritten -->
> **Section status: CURRENT** - reviewed 2026-11-24; not tied to specific files, so it never goes stale.
<!-- docsync:auto:end -->

<!-- How to prove a replica matches the original. Every item must be checkable with a yes/no. -->

## Functional parity
- [ ] A fresh install with `MISTRAL_API_KEY`, `ADMIN_EMAIL` and `ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD` starts, creates the Default workspace and the admin, and the admin is forced to change the password at `/admin/login`.
- [ ] An admin can create a workspace (key validated), a custom role, and an invited user. The invite link sets a password and signs the user in.
- [ ] Each of the 31 features in 01_overview/03_feature_inventory.md passes its "How to verify" (feature 18, libraries, passes only if the known `_HEADERS` bug was deliberately fixed or deliberately reproduced).
- [ ] The Orchestrator creates a working Mistral agent from a one-sentence need, and the timeline shows the stages understand, equip, ground, design, govern, author, verify and answer.
- [ ] The AI planner produces a saved, validated and verified workflow, with the stages understand, contract, plan, build, assemble, govern, check, verify and deliver.
- [ ] A workflow runs locally to completion, and its steps appear live.
- [ ] A published workflow runs on Mistral Workflows through the per-workspace worker.
- [ ] Human-review steps pause the run until approve, edit or reject; edits flow into the next step.
- [ ] Refine with AI proposes a revision with a diff; apply, undo and restore work.
- [ ] Tool synthesis produces a versioned tool in the Tool Service registry; pending, approve, reject and activate work.
- [ ] Closing the browser mid-run and reopening resumes the run's stream from the last seq.
- [ ] User decisions show a countdown and take the default on timeout.
- [ ] Settings changes take effect without restart and survive a restart; reset restores defaults.
- [ ] Settings → Cleanup deletes the chosen areas locally and at Mistral, then re-seeds.
- [ ] Every page in `frontend-3/src/routes/` exists with the same URL.

## Data parity
- [ ] The backend database has exactly the 46 tables listed in 02_architecture/04_data_model.md, with the same column names, types, nullability and defaults, plus `workspace_id` on the scoped tables.
- [ ] The Tool Service database has `tools` and `synthesis_jobs` with the same columns.
- [ ] Seeds match:
  - the 5 system roles with the same permission sets (26 permission keys);
  - the catalog seed YAML loaded in sorted order;
  - the recommended rules;
  - the tool-safety rules (switched off);
  - the built-in process template;
  - the Tool Service native tools.
- [ ] Identifier formats match:
  - catalog concept ids are dotted paths;
  - worker task queues are `DEPLOYMENT_NAME`, or `<base>-<workspace id first 8 chars>`;
  - compiled modules are `workflow_<name>.py`;
  - uploads are `<YYYYmmdd_HHMMSS>_<8 hex><ext>`;
  - vault references are `vault:<ref>`;
  - cookie names are `mdat_session` and `mdat_admin`.
- [ ] Settings overrides are stored in `runtime_settings.json`, not in the database.
- [ ] JSON stored in Text columns has the same shapes (workflow definitions, revisions, run events, rule params). A database from the original opens with the replica.

## Behavioural parity
- [ ] Model routes match `llm_routes.py` and `tool-service/app/llm/routes.py`: the roles, `mistral-medium-2604` primary, `mistral-large-4` fallback, the efforts and timeouts per role, Codestral excluded from code roles, and fallback ≠ primary.
- [ ] Every prompt in `backend/app/prompts*.py` and `tool-service/app/synthesis/prompts/*.py` is byte-identical.
- [ ] Decision-layer behaviour matches:
  - concurrency 6 per key;
  - hedge after 45 s;
  - 4 rate-limit retries with jittered backoff from 2 s;
  - JSON fence-tolerant parsing;
  - repair rounds;
  - never-fatal fallback.
- [ ] Run manager constants match: flush 0.75 s, keep-alive 15 s, retention 600 s, decision timeout 120 s, extend 30–3600 s, run slots 4 per workspace (FIFO), and the waiting messages are the same.
- [ ] Synthesis limits match: max attempts 4, wall clock 900 s, 3 workers, sandbox 20 s and 512 MB, the fault classes, and the job event stream.
- [ ] Agent steps hedge to the fallback after 40 s and time out at 180 s. Human reviews wait up to 86400 s.
- [ ] The auth rules list is identical and in the same order (first match wins). Lockout after 5 failures for 15 min. The session lifetimes match.
- [ ] User-visible messages match the source verbatim, for example:
  - "Waiting for a free slot — N ahead of you";
  - "This question is no longer waiting for an answer.";
  - "Blocked by rule '<name>': stopped after N steps.";
  - "Workflow 'x' not found — save it first.";
  - the stage labels of the pipelines.
- [ ] Attachments are sent natively or converted exactly as in `services/attachments.py` (OCR `mistral-ocr-latest`, transcript `voxtral-mini-latest`).

## Non-functional
- [ ] Planning one workflow with `mistral-medium-2604` takes about as long as the original. The routing switch from large-4 made it ~10× faster; a replica on large-4 is not at parity.
- [ ] One workspace's runs cannot starve another's: there are per-key gates.
- [ ] The Tool Service is not reachable from outside the compose network; only Caddy is published.
- [ ] Vault values never appear in API lists, traces, logs or tool results.
- [ ] Generated code is verified in the sandbox (as `sandboxuser`, with limits) before registration.
- [ ] Writes from another origin are refused (the same-site check), and the cookies are httpOnly.
- [ ] Server shutdown within 30 s marks runs and executions interrupted, with no lost records.
- [ ] The backend runs as a single uvicorn worker.
